{{Quote|Nobody fights the Empire and wins, boy.|[[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] to [[Galen Marek]]|<ref name="TFU" />}}
The '''Imperial Era''', also called the '''Imperial Period''',<ref name="Warfare" /> took place from the [[Declaration of a New Order]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]&mdash;the transition of the democratic [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] into autocratic [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule&mdash;until the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The era was characterized by the beginning and later rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], giving the period its name. It was also known by such nicknames as the '''Imperial era''',<ref name="DT1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> the '''Dark Times''',<ref name="ANH" /> or the '''Birth of the Rebellion'''.<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Poor boy. The Sith always betray one another. But I'm sure you'll learn that soon enough.|[[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] to Starkiller, and her last words|audio=PoorBoy-TFU.flac|<ref name="TFU" />}}
The Imperial era consisted of isolated conflicts and events that occurred on certain rebellious planets which attempted to fight against the new Empire's reign. It also included the last weeks of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], and the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], usually considered the age before the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] occurred.

The Imperial Period brought about the pre-eminence of [[501st Legion/Legends|Vader's Fist]], the 501st Legion of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], who were responsible for suppressing many of the planetary revolts against the Imperial regime. This age was when&mdash;as one 501st trooper put it&mdash;the galaxy could protect and maintain an Empire, rather than build one. The Empire gained near-total control over the known galaxy, with the exception of a select few planets, in revolts that needed to be subjugated.

This age also showcased the fearsome [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] as the epitome of the Empire's dark rule. Many citizens of the Empire were encouraged to believe that an era of peace and prosperity had finally been achieved, and news of rebellions, great and small, was generally squelched, before it could encourage further conflict.
